Boss '''Zraska''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3640 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Zraska appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Voss]]. She is not directly involved in any quests, however she can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
